articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
articles.description: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

articles.title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
articles.description: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.

articles.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
articles.description: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

articles.title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
articles.description: Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.

articles.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
articles.description: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
articles.description: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.

articles.title: South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
articles.description: Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.

articles.title: Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
articles.description: Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg said its newest models are a step toward “personal superintelligence.”

articles.title: Aptos rolls out Encrypted Mempool to curb frontrunning, sandwich attacks
articles.description: The optional feature hides transaction details until their order is finalized, preventing bots from exploiting pending trades.

articles.title: AI Will Hit 40% of Jobs, IMF Warns. Young People Are First in Line
articles.description: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva says AI investment is holding global growth near 3%, with Asian chipmakers winning big, while warning of a 'slow-moving tsunami' for young workers.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
articles.description: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.

articles.title: FTX’s crypto mining venture is now used to advance AI
articles.description: The defunct exchange acquired a 20% stake in Genesis Digital Assets before FTX declared bankruptcy in November 2022.

articles.title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
articles.description: Meta's new flagship beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude on memory, legal and marathon coding tests, but independent rankings still put Anthropic's Opus 5.5 on top.

articles.title: From GTA V on iPhone to Free Photoshop: This AI Tool Is Upending Software
articles.description: REA, a free toolkit that hands AI agents the keys to reverse engineering, crossed 100,000 GitHub stars in a week as AI-decompiled game mods, console ports, and Adobe clones flood the internet.

articles.title: Solana Treasury Firm DeFi Development Keeps Buying SOL as CHAD Preferred Stock Hits Record
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed company now holds about 2.59 million SOL, but its weekly purchases keep shrinking.

articles.title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom
articles.description: With just 22 days until the US midterm elections, a crypto-aligned committee has announced another major ad expenditure to support “pro-crypto” candidates in 2026.

articles.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
articles.description: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

articles.title: Ripple-Backed Evernorth Hits Nasdaq Holding 473 Million XRP Worth Far Less Than It Paid
articles.description: Evernorth's XRPN shares began trading Monday after its SPAC merger closed, but 80% of SPAC investors cashed out first and its XRP stash is worth roughly 40% less than at signing.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners face widening AI financing costs as lenders scrutinize deals
articles.description: The Bitcoin mining industry needs roughly $50 billion to complete planned AI infrastructure projects, with IREN, Riot Platforms and HIVE Digital facing major funding gaps.

articles.title: Bitcoin Spooked? Crypto Fear and Greed Index Drops to Pre-Rally August Lows
articles.description: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index has dropped to 56 from an August peak of 82, as oil, bond yields, and ETF outflows hit Bitcoin in October.

articles.title: Ledger Says All Confirmed Cases in Suspected $87M Drain Tied to Reseller CryptoBilis
articles.description: The wallet manufacturer said its own systems and direct sales are unaffected, and that the reseller has stopped selling hardware wallets.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops 2.2% as Ukraine, Iran strikes send oil toward one-month high
articles.description: Bitcoin price action stayed rangebound after failing to sustain above $84,000 into the Wall Street open on rising oil prices.

articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.description: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: NEXTPredict Paid $12,000 to Hedge Its Conference on a Prediction Market
articles.description: Where event insurance deals with scrapped shows and what happens inside the venue, NEXTPredict is focusing on flight cancellations.

articles.title: XRP Ledger’s Payment Engine Had a Counterfeiting Bug Hiding Since 2015
articles.description: An integer overflow in the payment engine, dormant since 2015, could have let an attacker mint spendable XRP beyond the token’s total supply.

articles.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
articles.description: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

articles.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
articles.description: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.

articles.title: XRP treasury Evernorth’s shares rise 5% at Nasdaq opening print
articles.description: Evernorth’s share price rose by 5% as investors welcomed the Nasdaq debut of the first pure-play XRP digital asset treasury.

articles.title: Ledger implant tests Bitcoin ETFs as safer custodial solutions than hardware wallets
articles.description: The discovery of an unauthorized Ledger hardware implant reignited debate on whether Bitcoin ETFs are safer than self-custodying Bitcoin via hardware wallet devices.

articles.title: Bitmine Adds $32M in Ethereum as Tom Lee Says Firm Is Nearly 'Done Stacking'
articles.description: The Ethereum treasury firm now holds 6.03 million ETH, 4.9% of supply, as Lee predicts the biggest crypto bull market yet.

articles.title: Strategy Scoops Up $21.5M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $192M in STRC
articles.description: The purchase lifts Strategy's holdings to 848,250 BTC and follows a $176 million repurchase of STRC preferred stock the week before.

articles.title: Strategy adds 250 Bitcoin as holdings reach 848,250 BTC
articles.description: Michael Saylor’s Strategy said Bitcoin holdings reached 848,250 BTC after its latest purchase, while maintaining a $4.88 billion cash reserve.

articles.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
articles.description: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

articles.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
articles.description: Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.

articles.title: Australia proposes leverage caps for crypto-settled derivatives
articles.description: ASIC’s proposal would extend leverage limits and protections against negative balances to certain derivatives settled in digital assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin Ranges Near $83K as Traders Look to US Inflation Data
articles.description: October rate-hike odds have slumped, but analysts say Treasury yields at two-decade highs are still keeping a lid on risk appetite.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
articles.description: Bitcoin and gold hold steady as a firm dollar and rising bond yields weigh on sentiment, while IREN secures a multiyear cloud services deal with Anthropic.

articles.title: BTC price support holds ahead of US CPI data: Three things Bitcoin traders need to know this week
articles.description: Bitcoin traders braced for inflation-based volatility after BTC price action preserved key weekly support around $82,500.

articles.title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
articles.description: Coins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands hit another, complicating cross-border crisis response.

articles.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
articles.description: Loans use third-party custodians for bitcoin holdings and rely on court-ordered sales if borrowers default.

articles.title: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
articles.description: SWI Group said it would use the proceeds from an 800 million-euro ($894 million) fundraise to transform Genesis Digital Assets, acquired from the FTX bankruptcy, from a bitcoin miner to an AI-focused data center.

articles.title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
articles.description: The CoinDesk 80 has risen around 3% in 24 hours, more than double the CoinDesk 5, while spot bitcoin ETFs lost $681 million last week.

articles.title: UK Freezes $12M London Penthouse of Alleged Prince Group Finance Chief
articles.description: Thet Li is accused of running the finances of a scam empire tied to $14 billion in Bitcoin the U.S. has moved to seize.

articles.title: Kraken parent clears Dubai’s final hurdle for dirham trading rollout
articles.description: Payward received full market approval from Dubai’s VARA to expand its digital asset services in the UAE, building on the preliminary approval received in May.

articles.title: Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
articles.description: Standard Chartered has launched custody for Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to let institutions use the tokens as trading collateral.

articles.title: U.S. inflation, Ethereum upgrade talks: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.description: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 12.

articles.title: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
articles.description: Jeonbuk Bank reportedly began offering Bitcoin-backed loans to corporate customers, with a third-party custodian holding the cryptocurrency used as collateral.

articles.title: Why a bug that could have threatened XRP's 100 billion supply cap stayed hidden for years
articles.description: The XRP Ledger Foundation said normal parameters never triggered the bug that could have broken XRP's supply cap, which is why it was undetected for years.

articles.title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
articles.description: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in a device linked to crypto losses at CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller. The company says confirmed cases are limited and its internal systems remain unaffected.

articles.title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
articles.description: The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.

articles.title: DATA Network to migrate to Sui, retire own chain
articles.description: The migration is backed by a $30 million investment from Sui Foundation.

articles.title: Bitcoin pulls back from $84,000 as oil recovers, ETFs bleed over $600 million
articles.description: Bitcoin reversed early gains as oil bounced back to over $92. Analysts express concerns over large outflows from spot ETFs last week.

articles.title: French lawmakers back reporting rule for crypto wallets over $112K
articles.description: Holders could face fines of up to 10,000 euros for failing to declare qualifying assets.

articles.title: XRP Ledger defends emergency patch for unlimited XRP bug
articles.description: The XRP Ledger Foundation pushed back against claims that its emergency security patch was forced on network operators.

articles.title: Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds ’18 trillion XRP’ bug: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: A user reports buying a tampered Ledger from a big retailer in Europe. Security researchers use AI to uncover a “$94 billion” XRP bug — but receive just a $250K bounty.

articles.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
articles.description: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

articles.title: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
articles.description: An IMF analysis found that more than half of tokenized stock trading happens outside U.S. market hours, though the roughly $2.3 billion market remains more volatile and less liquid than traditional equities.

articles.title: Saylor teases Strategy Bitcoin buying after ending September with STRC buybacks
articles.description: Investors will have to wait an extra day to find out if and how much Strategy added to its Bitcoin treasury in the first week of October.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana ETFs All in the Red for October
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs have seen $386.3 million in net outflows through the first seven trading days of October, while Ethereum funds have now posted nine straight days of losses.

articles.title: Clarity's failure could speed crypto innovation while shielding incumbents
articles.description: Executives see openings for tokenization, DeFi and dealmaking, while lawyers warn agency action leaves spot-market oversight and lasting certainty unresolved.

articles.title: President Trump declares 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
articles.description: "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well," said Ukrainian President Zelensky.

articles.title: How Zcash Plans to Hide Your Keys From AI and Quantum Attacks
articles.description: Zakura, a Zcash full node developer, says it expects hash-based signatures to land in Zcash in January, and is rolling out a privacy tool for rotating transparent addresses this week.

articles.title: IMF finds demand for tokenized stocks, says the market is still volatile, illiquid
articles.description: Investors are using blockchain-based shares for smaller and after-hours trades. The IMF says liquidity, legal rules and settlement systems have not caught up.

articles.title: Coldcard says it’s investigating how phishing link appeared on its X account
articles.description: Company advised users not to visit or interact with the link in question and said it will share any further verified updates.

articles.title: Ledger confirms unauthorized hardware implant, says losses may exceed $86M
articles.description: Ledger said the incident appeared to be isolated to a single reseller and its Southeast Asian market.

articles.title: CFTC proposals aimed at separating prediction markets from casino gambling
articles.description: The two measures attempt to set the stage for a potential US Supreme Court battle over federal and state jurisdiction.

articles.title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
articles.description: A proposed rule would expressly fold event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather into the “swap” definition, while an interim rule excludes casino-style gambling—sharpening the agency’s claim to exclusive jurisdiction.

articles.title: This Sam Altman-Backed Life Insurer Runs Entirely on Bitcoin, and Just Raised $37.5 Million
articles.description: The Bermuda-based insurer, which runs entirely on Bitcoin, drew the funding from existing backers led by Bain Capital Crypto after a record year driven by demand from wealthy families in Asia, Europe and the Middle East.

articles.title: Here’s a Way to Predict When AI Chatbots Will Turn Bad
articles.description: Physicists at George Washington University say a formula can estimate when an AI chatbot will flip from good answers to bad ones, and early tests on small models back it up.

articles.title: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
articles.description: A National Assembly committee adopted amendments taxing stablecoin swaps and crypto exits by wealthy holders, then rejected the 2027 budget's revenue section.

articles.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
articles.description: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

articles.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
articles.description: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

articles.title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
articles.description: “We’re ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time,” Sun said in a post on X.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
articles.description: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

articles.title: Tech chief says EU can fend off rogue AI risk: Report
articles.description: Recent incidents at OpenAI ‌and Anthropic stoke global concerns and fears that rogue AI agents may venture beyond human control.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Quietly Rehearsing for the Day After an AI Catastrophe
articles.description: Executives are war-gaming the political fallout of a major AI-driven cyberattack and preparing to brief Congress fast if and when necessary.

articles.title: Senate Democrat Presses Cantor Fitzgerald on Tether Ties and Lutnick Family Profits
articles.description: Sen. Richard Blumenthal wants Cantor Fitzgerald to open its records on Tether and on how much Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's family has earned from its business deal.

articles.title: Blockchain.com Seeks Approval for US Prediction Markets and Crypto Derivatives
articles.description: The crypto platform filed for designated contract market and futures commission merchant licenses, which would let it run its own regulated event-contract venue instead of relying on overseas partners.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Rough Week, But Traders Are Pricing In More Downside
articles.description: Bitcoin bounced after dipping to around $80,000. Traders are placing increasingly high odds BTC slips further before October is over.

articles.title: Ethereum L2 Starknet Jumps 20% After Saying It Wants to Become an L1
articles.description: Starknet is "actively considering" becoming its own blockchain, a move it says would make it the first fully quantum-resistant network by 2027.

articles.title: DWF Labs Subsidiaries Sue BitGo for $141 Million Over Early Token Sales
articles.description: The DWF Labs-linked firms allege in London’s High Court that BitGo sold discounted Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens roughly two months before their lock-up expired, cratering the value of their remaining holdings.

articles.title: New York AG Secures Up to $35M and Industry Ban From Ex-Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky
articles.description: Mashinsky owes New York $25 million if he fails to forfeit another $10 million, and $10 million more if he doesn't serve his full sentence.

articles.title: Ledger Probes Potential Theft of $87M in User Funds Tied to Crypto Wallet Reseller
articles.description: Ledger asked reseller CryptoBilis to pause sales and urged recent buyers not to set up their devices, as an onchain investigator tracked more than $86 million in suspected thefts.

articles.title: Bitcoin Bleeds in Uptober—How Low Can It Go? Experts Weigh In
articles.description: Experts highlight several support levels, from $83,000 down to $72,000, that Bitcoin may need to test in a bearish start to Uptober.

articles.title: UK Targets Cryptomus and TokenSpot in New Russia Sanctions Package
articles.description: The package hits five crypto and payment platforms, two of which handled transactions with Russia’s A7 network, the UK government said.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Uptober Turns Sour as Crypto Majors Slide
articles.description: Is this the beginning of a bigger selloff with the anniversary of 10/10 looming? Or just a leverage flush before the next leg up?

articles.title: Empire Market Co-Creator Sentenced to 40 Years Over $430M Dark Web Bazaar
articles.description: Raheim Hamilton forfeited some 1,230 BTC. His co-creator Thomas Pavey, who agreed to forfeit 1,584 BTC, is due to be sentenced this month.

articles.title: SIM-Swap Fraudster Who Spent Stolen Crypto on Gold Grills and Dubai Trips Jailed
articles.description: Ajay Shinjin helped steal nearly $265,000 in crypto after criminals hijacked BT customers' phone numbers in November 2021.

articles.title: AI Startup Manus Raises $500 Million After China Nixed Meta’s $2 Billion Acquisition
articles.description: Manus built a self-driving AI assistant before the hype, sold itself to Meta, then watched Beijing unwind the deal. Its first fresh money since: more than $500 million.

articles.title: Google Wants Gemini to Be Your Next Coworker—Complete With Its Own Email Address
articles.description: Google Cloud unveiled a single Gemini agent that takes goals instead of questions, works in the background for days, and can join a company as a staffer with its own inbox and calendar.
